UNDERSTAND YOUR OPTIONS

Water Filtration Systems

01

Define the concern

Taste, odor, sediment, and contaminants are different concerns. Review quality information or appropriate testing before selecting equipment. No filter addresses everything.

02

At the sink or throughout the home

Under-sink equipment treats one outlet. Whole-home equipment treats incoming water. Placement, flow, and service access affect selection.

03

Keep maintenance in the plan

Cartridges and media need replacement at manufacturer intervals. Ask about costs and access before installation.

EXPLORE THE DETAILS

A clearer picture.

Where do you want treated water?

Supply → selected under-sink system → compatible outlet. Consider space and cartridge access.

SERVICE QUESTIONS

Good questions. Useful answers.

Will a filter remove every contaminant?+

No. Performance depends on the model, certifications, and substances it reduces. Match equipment to a documented need.

Is filtration the same as softening?+

No. They address different concerns. Discuss which approach fits your water and goals.
